response.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as region_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(region_count) as total FROM region_counts), region_shares AS (SELECT rc.region_count, CAST(rc.region_count AS REAL) / tc.total as share FROM region_counts rc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM region_shares), above_avg_regions AS (SELECT rs.region_count, rs.share FROM region_shares rs CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc WHERE rs.share > asc.avg_share_value) SELECT SUM(region_count) as total_count_above_avg, AVG(share) as average_share_above_avg, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share_calc)) as avg_distance_above_avg FROM above_avg_regions
